target_customer: Crypto projects and token issuers distributing vested tokens to employees, investors and advisors, plus investors receiving tokens
problem: Token vesting and distribution was done by hand with spreadsheets and manual transactions, taking ops teams days each month and carrying the risk of costly errors.
business_model: B2B SaaS for token vesting, claims and distribution, with custody and on-chain execution services
product_category: Web3 token management and cap table software

founders.name: Bruno Faviero
founders.background_notes: Coverage says the team previously worked together at Maple; not independently verified.

technical_complexity.rationale: Smart contract vesting across multiple chains plus off-chain cap table, tax and custody workflows; secure handling of real value raised the bar above standard SaaS.

defensibility.rationale: Once a project's vesting contracts and records run through the platform they are hard to move, and issuer relationships compounded, but open protocols could be forked.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competing token managers were later bought by exchanges and custodians (Coinbase bought Liquifi in July 2025, Anchorage bought Hedgey in December 2025), and Magna itself was acquired by Payward in February 2026.

market_need_then: Founders interviewed for the YC pitch described hours or days of manual work each month to pay out token holders, and the 2021 to 2022 token boom produced many projects with vesting obligations.

branding.community_and_virality: Case studies with Dust Labs and Access Protocol; Solana ecosystem listings. No fan or merch evidence found.

brand_strength.rationale: The Carta for Web3 line was an easy shorthand and the company reported 160 plus projects and a peak of 60 billion dollars locked, but no evidence of community pull beyond B2B reputation.

outcome_analysis: Magna rode the 2022 token boom into a 15 million dollar seed at a reported 70 million dollar valuation and became a standard tool for token vesting, claiming 160 plus projects and a 60 billion dollar peak value locked. It survived the crypto downturn and was acquired by Payward, Kraken's parent, in February 2026, continuing as a standalone brand. Terms were not disclosed.
notes: Company docs reportedly list 18 million dollars raised in total, so later or additional funding may exist; coverage marked partial. One outlet gives 15.2 million for the seed. CB Insights is said to list a former name Maple Syrup; single source, not recorded as a rebrand. magna.so returned 403 to the fetch tool, not a dead site. No competitor sources dated near the batch were found (Sablier and Hedgey comparisons were 2025 to 2026 vendor posts), so the list is empty.
